"""Regression tests for report.py's SVG output: a label from the results or the command line is text, never markup.

Each generated SVG is read back with the standard library's XML parser (xml.etree.ElementTree), so a label that closes an
element, opens one, or adds an attribute fails the test as malformed XML or as an element that should not be there.

Run with: python3 bench/test_report.py
"""

import contextlib
import io
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import report  # noqa: E402

SVG = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
# Closes the <text> element, opens a script, and tries an attribute on the element that follows.
EVIL = '</text><script>alert(1)</script><text x="0" onload="alert(2)">'
ALLOWED_TAGS = {SVG + t for t in ("svg", "style", "text", "tspan", "path", "line", "rect")}


def parse(path):
    """The SVG as an XML parser reads it: raises ParseError on markup a label has broken."""
    return ET.parse(path).getroot()


def texts(root):
    """Every <text> element's content, after the parser has turned character references back into characters."""
    return [t.text or "" for t in root.iter(SVG + "text")]


def tags(root):
    return {el.tag for el in root.iter()}


class ReportTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    """A temporary image folder, and the module's label state put back after each test (main() fills LABELS from --label)."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.images = Path(self.tmp.name) / "images"
        self.images.mkdir()
        self.labels = dict(report.LABELS)
        self.pi_version = report.PI_VERSION[0]

    def tearDown(self):
        report.LABELS.clear()
        report.LABELS.update(self.labels)
        report.PI_VERSION[0] = self.pi_version
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def svg(self, name):
        return self.images / f"{name}.svg"


class EscapeTests(ReportTestCase):
    def test_special_characters_become_references(self):
        self.assertEqual(report.esc('&<>"\''), "&<>"'")

    def test_ordinary_text_is_unchanged(self):
        for text in ("Pi-Bolt", "Pi 1.0.3 on stock Bun 1.4.2", "Node 22", "1,234 ms", "2.9× faster"):
            self.assertEqual(report.esc(text), text)

    def test_unicode_is_kept(self):
        text = "Pi-Bolt – café 日本語 ×"
        self.assertEqual(report.esc(text), text)

    def test_characters_xml_cannot_carry_are_dropped(self):
        self.assertEqual(report.esc("a\x00b\x1fc\uffffd"), "abcd")

    def test_whole_values_are_escaped_once(self):
        # (A label that is itself a reference is data: its & becomes & and is not left as a reference.)
        self.assertEqual(report.esc("A & B"), "A &amp; B")


class ChartTests(ReportTestCase):
    def test_adversarial_label_cannot_inject_markup(self):
        report.chart(EVIL, EVIL, [(EVIL, "ms", {"pi-bolt": 10, EVIL: 20})], ["pi-bolt", EVIL], "light", self.svg("evil"))
        root = parse(self.svg("evil"))
        self.assertEqual(root.tag, SVG + "svg")
        self.assertEqual(tags(root) - ALLOWED_TAGS, set(), "an element not of the chart: an injected one")
        self.assertEqual(root.get("aria-label"), f"{EVIL}: {EVIL}")
        self.assertEqual(set(root.attrib), {"width", "height", "viewBox", "role", "aria-label"})
        self.assertIn(EVIL, texts(root))
        self.assertNotIn("&lt;", self.svg("evil").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertIn("<script>", self.svg("evil").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def test_ordinary_labels_draw_the_same_text(self):
        report.chart("Time", "Lower is better.", [("Panel", "ms", {"pi-bolt": 10, "bun": 20})],
                     ["pi-bolt", "bun"], "light", self.svg("ordinary"))
        root = parse(self.svg("ordinary"))
        self.assertEqual(texts(root), ["Time", "Lower is better.", "Panel", "Pi-Bolt", "10 ms", "2.0× faster",
                                       "Bun 1.4.2", "20 ms"])
        self.assertEqual(root.get("aria-label"), "Time: Lower is better.")
        self.assertNotIn("&", self.svg("ordinary").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def test_a_single_ampersand_is_escaped_once(self):
        report.chart("Q&A", "A & B", [("Panel", "ms", {"pi-bolt": 10, "bun": 20})],
                     ["pi-bolt", "bun"], "light", self.svg("amp"))
        content = self.svg("amp").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn(">Q&A<", content)
        self.assertIn(">A & B<", content)
        self.assertNotIn("&amp;", content)
        self.assertIn("Q&A", texts(parse(self.svg("amp"))))

    def test_unicode_label_survives_the_parser(self):
        label = "Pi-Bolt – café 日本語 ×"
        report.LABELS["café"] = label
        report.chart("Title", "Sub", [("Panel", "ms", {"café": 10})], ["café"], "dark", self.svg("unicode"))
        self.assertIn(label, texts(parse(self.svg("unicode"))))

    def test_control_characters_do_not_break_the_document(self):
        report.LABELS["ctl"] = "a\x00b\x1fc"
        report.chart("Title", "Sub", [("Panel", "ms", {"ctl": 10})], ["ctl"], "light", self.svg("control"))
        self.assertIn("abc", texts(parse(self.svg("control"))))


class HeroTests(ReportTestCase):
    def test_adversarial_label_cannot_inject_markup(self):
        report.hero([(EVIL, "ms", {"pi-bolt": 10, EVIL: 20}, "faster")], ["pi-bolt", EVIL], "light", self.svg("hero"),
                    EVIL, EVIL, [(EVIL, EVIL)])
        root = parse(self.svg("hero"))
        self.assertEqual(tags(root) - ALLOWED_TAGS, set(), "an element not of the tile: an injected one")
        self.assertEqual(root.get("aria-label"), EVIL)
        self.assertIn(EVIL, texts(root))
        # The large figure's unit keeps its <tspan> markup, and the text reads as before.
        tspan = next(root.iter(SVG + "tspan"))
        self.assertEqual(tspan.text, "ms")
        self.assertEqual("".join(next(t for t in root.iter(SVG + "text") if len(t)).itertext()), "10ms")

    def test_ordinary_hero_is_unchanged(self):
        report.hero([("Ready to type", "ms", {"pi-bolt": 100, "bun": 250}, "faster")], ["pi-bolt", "bun"], "light",
                    self.svg("ordinary"), "Title", "Subtitle", [("bun", "Bun")])
        root = parse(self.svg("ordinary"))
        self.assertIn("100ms", [t.text for t in root.iter(SVG + "text") if t.text == "100"])
        self.assertIn("2.5× faster than Bun", texts(root))

    return ET.parse(path).getroot()

    """Every <text> element's content, after the parser has turned character references back into characters."""
    return [t.text or "" for t in root.iter(SVG + "text")]

        report.LABELS.clear()

content.text:
| `run-suite.sh` | Runs all of the benchmarks above into one results folder, then `report.py`: what the README and docs/BENCHMARKS.md show. |
| `run-suite.ps1` | The same on Windows: Pi-Bolt, Pi on stock Bun, Node 22 and Node 24; `conpty_check.py` for `tmux_check.py`, and `pauses.py` (frames and GC pauses), `long_answer.py` and `large_write.py` too. Writes `environment.txt` (CPU, Windows build, Defender, power) and `summary.md`. |
| `report.py` | Draws the charts (light and dark SVG) and prints the tables, from a results folder. Text that goes into an SVG (titles, `--label` text, build and step names from the results) is escaped first, so `&`, `<`, `>` and quotes are drawn as characters and a label cannot add elements or attributes; the files are UTF-8. |
| `test_report.py` | Regression tests for `report.py`'s SVG output: hostile and ordinary labels, read back with an XML parser. Run with `python3 bench/test_report.py`. |
| `fake_model.py`, `fake_model_tools.py`, `fake_model_stress.py` | The scripted OpenAI-compatible model servers the tools start. |
| `harness.py` | Shared pieces: build parsing, model server, Pi home, pseudo-terminal, CPU and memory readings. |
| `fixtures/` | Four Pi source files (MIT, from Pi) that the scripted model asks Pi to read. |
| `floor/floor.c` | The process floor (`benchmark.py --floor`): a minimal native program that takes Pi's arguments and answers each scenario as Pi does. |
